text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I spotted a Tracen student practicing martial arts, but...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: In that case, it's time for a dojo challengeee!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To improve our skills even further for the U.A.F.,
gaining combat experience through cross-disciplinary matches
is the absolute best way!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Fighting stronger opponents, learning, and elevating each other! Oh man, that's so hype!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Now, to go dojo-crashing—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm. Are you going to do some dojo busting as well?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You two "as well"...?
Wait, Oguri-san, did you go dojo-crashing too?

text_block_list.name: Passing Macho Man
text_block_list.text:
Is that...
the wandering dojo crusher, Oguri Cap!?
The one rumored to visit dojos far and wide and defeat them all—

text_block_list.name: Passerby in a Judo Uniform
text_block_list.text: "Is that the dojo where even battle-hardened veterans were crushed like babies, leaving not a blade of grass behind...?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing her, she's probably talking about food.
Even with that thought in mind, my curiosity gets the better of me,
and I find myself stopping in my tracks.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Now, we're going to try another "dojo challenge."
The next one is our final opponent... the toughest one yet.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"A hellish barrage of attacks, coming one after another...
It is said no one has ever defeated him."
—Or so the story goes.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I want to try. If I conquer this,
I’ll finally obtain the title of the ‘strongest’...!”

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, Oguri-san has entered the U.A.F. as well...
Does that mean we're aiming for the same heights?"
choice_data_list: (Could it be... she's really challenging dojos...?)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Oguri-senpai, the dojo crasher.
Unfortunately for you, today's the day
you're walking away empty-handed.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Because that signboard is gonna be mine, that's why!
It's a battle to the finish!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, isn't that a bit too heavy for the two of you?
Don't push yourselves.
I'll gladly take it home for you...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I won't lose to either of you.

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Now, to go dojo-crashing!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's really out to challenge the dojo...!
She apparently intends to storm the dojo where a powerhouse with the "Hellish Flurry" resides, but—
choice_data_list: (What kind of battle will this turn out to be...!?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My curiosity got the better of me, so I followed after
them along with the crowd of onlookers—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's the dojo challenge dish from the Morimen Dojo flagship store:
"Infinite Yakisoba Hell."
choice_data_list: (I knew you'd go with that one!!)
(You went with that one after all!?)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Your toughest opponent yet was fried noodles all along!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Yeah, it is.
The yakisoba at the main restaurant is on a whole different level compared to the branches.
It's an endless hell served wanko soba style.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If I can conquer this, I'll be able to order the "Supreme Yakisoba"...
The legendary secret menu item, I must taste it no matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
……J-Just because things didn't go as planned,
I cannot simply run away.
Infinite Hell…… I will overcome it too!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
S-Stop, please...!
S-Stop ittt...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The only one to overcome the "Infinite Hell" and claim the title
of "Strongest" was Oguri Cap, and Oguri Cap alone...!
A truly terrifying, wandering dojo buster!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A dojo-breaker is simply far too dangerous.
As a Tracen Academy Trainer, I cannot just stand by and overlook this...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "...You are right. Had we been acquaintances, it might be different, but barging into an unfamiliar dojo unannounced is rather impolite. ...I was thoughtless."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see, it's dangerous, is it...?
Then "Infinite Yakisoba Hell" will have to be postponed...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Apparently the yakisoba at the main "Morimen Dojo" branch has a portion size that puts the other branches to shame...
I knew it, it really is dangerous...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Y-You were talking about the yakisoba...?
Well... I guess that makes sense too..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "...Bamboo-san, shall we continue our training over here...?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, is there really no way?
I still want to conquer 'Infinite Hell'
and reach the 'Ultimate Yakisoba'..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "As expected, Oguri Cap was simply Oguri Cap."
